title: Why We Choose Flutter for Odoo Mobile Frontlines (And Why WebViews Fail)
content:
When software teams attempt to build mobile apps for Odoo, the common shortcut is wrapping Odoo's responsive web interface inside an Android/iOS WebView container.

On paper, it sounds fast and cheap.

In reality on the warehouse or delivery floor, it is a disaster:
- 4-second latency between button tap and server response.
- Janky scrolling when navigating 200 order line items.
- Frequent blank screens whenever the network flutters.
- Clunky camera barcode scanning that drains battery and misses 2 out of 5 codes under dim lighting.

At Scando, we standardize our frontline mobile architecture on native Flutter connected via optimized API endpoints:

1. Native 60 FPS UI: Flutter compiles directly to machine ARM code. The interface responds with zero latency, providing immediate haptic feedback.
2. Direct Hardware Barcode Integration: Instead of relying on slow camera autofocus, our Flutter apps talk directly to the hardware laser scan engines in Zebra and Honeywell terminals via native OEM SDKs. Scan time: 100 milliseconds.
3. Local State Isolation: Business workflows run locally using SQLite and state management. The driver or picker can complete their entire route without a single drop in responsiveness, auto-syncing in the background.

Never compromise frontline user experience with web wrappers. Engineering native performance is what turns software into an operational asset.
notes: Technical engineering post for Scando LinkedIn. Positions Scando's custom development capabilities for GCC high-throughput clients.
